definitions.rationale: This is the base equation defining the mathematical factorial summary at zero.
This is the positive-input recurrence defining the mathematical factorial summary.
definitions.text:
rule mathFactorial(N) => mathFactorial(N -Int 1) *Int N
    requires N >Int 0

definitions.rationale: This is the base equation defining the mathematical triangular-sum summary at zero.
This is the positive-input recurrence defining the mathematical triangular-sum summary.
definitions.text:
rule mathTriangle(N) => mathTriangle(N -Int 1) +Int N
    requires N >Int 0

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the expected value at a positive even index to be its factorial.
definitions.text:
rule expectedAt(N) => mathFactorial(N)
    requires N >Int 0 andBool N %Int 2 ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the expected value at a positive odd index to be its triangular sum.
definitions.text:
rule expectedAt(N) => mathTriangle(N)
    requires N >Int 0 andBool N %Int 2 =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the expected result list by initializing its completion summary.
definitions.text:
rule expected(N) => expectedCompletion(1, N, 1, 0, .List)
    requires N >=Int 0

definitions.rationale: This is the terminating equation for the expected-completion list summary once the next index exceeds the bound.
definitions.text:
rule expectedCompletion(I, N, _F, _T, L) => L
    requires I >Int N

definitions.rationale: This recurrence defines expected completion at an even index by updating the product and sum accumulators and appending the product.
definitions.text:
rule expectedCompletion(I, N, F, T, L)
    => expectedCompletion(
         I +Int 1, N, F *Int I, T +Int I,
         L ListItem(F *Int I))
    requires I <=Int N andBool I %Int 2 ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: This recurrence defines expected completion at an odd index by updating the product and sum accumulators and appending the sum.
definitions.text:
rule expectedCompletion(I, N, F, T, L)
    => expectedCompletion(
         I +Int 1, N, F *Int I, T +Int I,
         L ListItem(T +Int I))
    requires I <=Int N andBool I %Int 2 =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: This macro expansion defines the named solutionLoop proof term as the translated loop AST.
definitions.text:
rule solutionLoop =>
    While(Compare(Name("i"), CmpOp("<=", Name("n"))),
      Assign(
        Name("factorial"),
        BinOp("*", Name("factorial"), Name("i")))
      Assign(Name("total"), BinOp("+", Name("total"), Name("i")))
      If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("i"), Int(2)), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
        Assign(
          Name("result"),
          BinOp("+", Name("result"), ListExpr(Name("factorial")))),
        Assign(
          Name("result"),
          BinOp("+", Name("result"), ListExpr(Name("total")))))
      Assign(Name("i"), BinOp("+", Name("i"), Int(1))))

definitions.rationale: This macro expansion defines the named solution proof term as the complete translated function AST.
definitions.text:
rule solution =>
    Module(
      FuncDef("f", Params("n"),
        Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
        Assign(Name("factorial"), Int(1))
        Assign(Name("total"), Int(0))
        Assign(Name("i"), Int(1))
        solutionLoop
        Return(Name("result"))))
